result.summary: Adds an automated copyright header linter to repository checks. Also updates existing source files to add or correct copyright header formatting.
result.problem: Source files across the repository can lack consistent copyright notices, and without automated enforcement, new or modified files can introduce missing or malformed headers undetected.
evidence: PR description cites following up on a review suggestion: 'Followsup to https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34106#issuecomment-7138103662.'
result.scope_notes: The diff was not provided, but metadata indicates changes spanning 14 files covering both linter tooling and header fixes.
result.card: This PR introduces a copyright header linter to test scripts and updates headers across 14 repository files. It prevents missing or inconsistent copyright notices by enforcing header requirements in automated lint checks. The change follows up on discussion in PR #34106.
uncertainties: The diff and file list were not provided, so the exact linter implementation and target files cannot be inspected directly.

risk.why: A flaw would only cause CI lint failures or allow malformed headers through, causing no runtime impact on node behavior.
